description: Logical calls of vector network analyzers (VNA). PROVISIONAL: written from the manuals of the Zenko LiteVNA, the Siglent SNA/SHN series and the Rohde & Schwarz ZNB/ZNL (mandatory = documented in every manual of the category). Complex results are returned as arrays of real and imaginary parts. Calibration is a flow: calibration_begin, calibration_measure (once per standard), calibration_apply.

calibration_standard.description: calibration standard connected to the test port(s)

calibration_kind.description: ONE_PORT: reflection calibration of one port (OPEN, SHORT, LOAD); TRANSMISSION_RESPONSE: normalisation of the transmission from port to port2 (THRU); TWO_PORT: full two-port calibration (OPEN, SHORT, LOAD on both ports and THRU)

sparameters.description: dict with "frequency" (array, Hz), "parameters" ({name: {"real": array, "imaginary": array}} for each selected S-parameter) and "calibrated" (bool: the calibration of the application or of the instrument was applied)

calibration_data.description: calibration of an instrument whose calibration is computed by the driver (LiteVNA): grid (start Hz, step Hz, points), reflection error terms and transmission reference, as lists of [real, imaginary]

identification_query.description: instrument identification (manufacturer, model, hardware and firmware)

set_frequency_sweep.description: linear frequency sweep from start to stop frequency with a number of points

run_sweep.description: start a sweep and discard the data of the previous one (read_sparameters then returns this sweep)

read_sparameters.description: sweep (when the instrument needs it) and read the frequencies and the complex values of the asked S-parameters

calibration_begin.description: choose the calibration and the ports; the standards are then measured with calibration_measure

port.description: test port (the source port of a transmission calibration)

port2.description: second test port (the receiving port of a transmission calibration, the other port of a two-port calibration)

calibration_measure.description: measure a calibration standard connected to the port(s) given to calibration_begin

calibration_apply.description: compute the calibration from the measured standards and use it for the next read_sparameters

set_correction_state.description: use (true) or bypass (false) the calibration in read_sparameters

calibration_clear.description: forget the measured standards and the calibration

calibration_export.description: the calibration computed by the driver, to save it with the project (only for instruments that do not keep it themselves)

calibration_import.description: restore a calibration exported by calibration_export for the same frequency sweep
